summary.text: Rob McColley was unanimously elected President of the Ohio Senate in January 2025 and represents Senate District 1 in northwest Ohio. He began serving in the Senate after being appointed in December 2017.

paragraphs.text: McColley graduated from Napoleon High School in 2003, earned a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a major in Finance from The Ohio State University, and received a Juris Doctorate from the University of Toledo College of Law in 2010.
Before being elected State Representative, he served in the Community Improvement Corporation of Henry County overseeing economic development efforts.
He represented the 81st Ohio House District, where he served as Assistant Majority Whip, before moving to the Senate, where he was Senate Majority Floor Leader for the 135th General Assembly.
He lives in Napoleon with his wife, Denise, their daughter, and their twin boys.
